title: Auto-Pigeon workspace manifest
description: The repositories that make up an Auto-Pigeon workspace. Deliberately minimal: this is shared TOPOLOGY, not a configuration dump. Machine paths, the $MAPPER_ROOT data root, ports, hostnames and secrets are per-machine or per-service and are excluded by construction — additionalProperties is false at every level, so a well-meaning addition fails validation rather than quietly becoming a contract.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, so an editor can validate the manifest as it is typed.

schema_version.description: This manifest format's version, not any repository's version.

repositories.description: Every repository in the workspace. Order is presentational; consumers must not depend on it.

alias.description: The short uppercase alias used throughout the prompts, handoffs and agent tooling, e.g. "AUP".

directory.description: The repository's directory name inside the workspace. A bare name, never a path: a manifest that could say "../elsewhere" would be describing one machine's layout rather than the workspace's shape.

clone_url.description: The HTTPS clone URL. HTTPS only, so the clone scripts' credential-cache behaviour applies uniformly and no SSH key layout is assumed.

role.description: One line on what the repository is for. Documentation; nothing branches on it.
